tool_args.rationale: The five paid rows vary u_now and s_grad while nuisance inputs are fixed; this provides adequate variation for the four parameters. The supplied verified mechanism specifies the barrier-modulated siphon with u_n=u_now/3, and there is no narrow-gradient or supercritical-regime trigger for another probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed s_grad span is 1.65 (0.25 to 1.9), far above the stated 0.08 ambiguity trigger; no additional measurement is needed to identify the inhibition dependence.
All observed s_grad values are at or below 2.25, below the stated supercritical threshold of 2.36, so the ordinary four-parameter barrier-siphon model is indicated.
These alternatives do not match the verified co-activated barrier-modulated siphon mechanism and omit the observed sink-gradient dependence.
